snippet.title: Beholder 4 | Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://s.team/a/5522030

Beholder 4 returns to a totalitarian State where your choices matter. Live a double life as an official and underground agent. Spy, sabotage, build relationships, and decide others' fates. But brace for a knock: the police are coming, and your home is full of evidence.

The State demands your loyalty. The underground needs your help. How long can you keep both sides in the dark?

Follow Beholder on social media:

Discord: https://discord.gg/alawar
X (Twitter): https://x.com/beholder_game
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BeholderGame/
